Specification: This module models a small TLC-driven benchmarking harness that runs a fixed collection of TLA+ specifications sequentially with different worker counts and classifies the outcome of each run by the external process exit code. The state records the selected run number, worker count, benchmark spec name, and an IO process record, and the main action either launches TLC through an IOUtils environment-execution primitive or observes one of several terminal outcome classes: done, safety violation, liveness violation, or other violation. The file is not a protocol or fault-tolerant algorithm specification itself; instead it is an orchestration specification for executing model-checking jobs, using TLC and IO utilities, with deadlock checking disabled in the embedded TLC config block.
FunctionApplication: IOEnvExecTemplate([ run |-> run, spec |-> spec, timestamp |-> Timestamp ], CmdTemplate, <<AbsolutePathOfTLC, ToString(workers), spec, LogFile(run, workers, spec)>>)
RecordConstructor: [ run |-> run, spec |-> spec, timestamp |-> Timestamp ]

CHANGE LOG
Field: ActionDefNames | Change: added SafetyViolation, LivenessViolation, Other, Done | Reason: these are top-level action operators with state-action form; they constrain current state and include UNCHANGED, so they are action definitions.
Field: NamesInLet | Change: renamed to LetInNames and kept empty | Reason: required field name per prompt; there are no LET-bound names in the file.
Field: FunctionApplication | Change: added TLCGet(\"config\"), ToString(run), ToString(workers), PrintT(...), IOEnvExecTemplate(...), LogFile(run, workers, spec) entries | Reason: these applications appear literally in the TLA+ file and the field was incorrectly empty.
Field: RecordAccess | Change: added TLCGet(\"config\").install | Reason: this record field access appears literally in AbsolutePathOfTLC and must be captured.
Field: ArithmeticOps | Change: removed + | Reason: + does not appear anywhere in the TLA+ file; only unary/binary - and ^ appear.
Field: ProofCommands | Change: added CHECK_DEADLOCK | Reason: the embedded config block contains CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE, so this command appears in the file.
Field: Completeness | Change: verified top-level operator count file=12, JSON=12 | Reason: Phase 2 count matches; no missing or extra OperatorDefNames.
DivisionNotes: ValueDef by elimination: AbsolutePathOfTLC, Timestamp, CmdTemplate, LogFile, and Specs are non-action operator definitions that compute values rather than state predicates or temporal properties.
Partition count: StatePredicate(0) + TemporalProperty(0) + Init(1) + ValueDef(5) + ActionDefNames(6) = OperatorDefNames(12). Verified.
All FunctionConstructor entries are [S -> T] forms; FunctionConstructor_ByDomain is empty.

The only FunctionConstructor entry, [exitValue |-> -42, stdout |-> "", stderr |-> ""], is a record constructor written with square brackets. Per the required two-way split, it is placed in FunctionConstructor_SetType by elimination so that FunctionConstructor_ByDomain plus FunctionConstructor_SetType exactly equals FunctionConstructor.
TemporalNesting is false. No temporal operator [], <>, or ~> appears in any operator body in this file.
